rule.statement: In a rei vindicatio action, the Plaintiff has to establish the title to the land on a balance of probability, not with mathematical precision or beyond reasonable doubt.
rule.supporting_quote: In a rei vindicatio action, the Plaintiff has to establish the title to the land. Plaintiff need not establish the title with mathematical precision nor to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt as in a criminal case. The Plaintiff's task is to establish the case on a balance of probability.
